question_text: He did not like _______ leaving the class early.
explanation: The verb 'like' takes an object pronoun. 'Us' is the correct object pronoun here.

question_text: Tennyson and Browning lived about the same time and are _______ poets.
explanation: 'Contemporaries' is a noun meaning people living at the same time.

question_text: Because the referee was partial and his opponent rough, the loser of the wrestling match received _______ cheers than the winner.
explanation: 'Many more' is used with count nouns (cheers).

question_text: They went to the market and bought a suitcase and _______ bag.
explanation: The correct order of adjectives is size (big), color (brown), material (leather).

question_text: After our series of quarrels, it would be _______ to pretend that I have any more regard for him.
explanation: 'Hypocritical' means pretending to have feelings or virtues one does not possess.

question_text: The governor commended the society's _______ services to the nation.
explanation: 'Humanitarian' is the adjective used to describe services concerned with human welfare.

question_text: Bilaminu sent the expensive present to one Miss Sanda of the United African Organization and not to _______ of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
explanation: 'A Miss Sanda' is used to refer to one of possibly several people with that name.

question_text: Many goods, tape recorders and cameras find a ready market _______.
explanation: 'Anywhere' is the correct adverb of place here.

question_text: He must be a good student because he is a _______ reader.
explanation: A 'voracious' reader reads a lot.

question_text: _______ the problem was simple, students were able to solve it.
explanation: 'Although' introduces a concessive clause.

question_text: A little learning is a dangerous thing, _______?
explanation: The statement is positive, so the question tag is negative: 'isn't it'.

question_text: _______ lawyers enrolled at the Nigerian Bar last year.
explanation: 'A few' is used with count nouns to mean a small number.

question_text: As many as cause _______ fuss possible.
explanation: 'A little' is used with the uncountable noun 'fuss'.

question_text: From a little experience, one can see that many people _______ from one day's salary.
explanation: The correct comparative structure is 'more money'.

question_text: On his way back the boy ran into a long procession of men, women and children in _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is opinion (beautiful), color (white), participle (flowing), noun (gowns).

question_text: I cannot offer you another loan. I have _______ money left in my account.
explanation: 'Little' means hardly any (negative).

question_text: My little daughter has... sight, hence, she now wears glasses.
explanation: 'Defective' means not working properly, fitting the context of needing glasses.

question_text: The suspect defrauded his _______ victims of large sums of money.
explanation: An 'unsuspecting' victim is one who is unaware of the danger or deception.

question_text: The austerity of the times has made people to be more _______ in their spending.
explanation: To be 'circumspect' means to be wary and cautious.

question_text: The company representative in Nigeria is a _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is opinion (smart), size (little), origin (Japanese).

question_text: The shipping company advertised for _______ accountants.
option_a: two young, but highly competent, Nigerian
option_c: two, young, but highly competent, Nigerian
explanation: The correct adjective order is number, age, opinion, origin.

question_text: Jimoh is noted for his _______ attitude to his seniors at school.
explanation: To be 'respectful' means to show respect.

question_text: The police report was _______ to that of the eye witness.
explanation: The report was 'similar' to the eye witness account.

question_text: Insects can become _______ to insecticides.
explanation: Insects become 'resistant' to insecticides over time.

question_text: Many students have joined the _______.
explanation: The context likely refers to a religious movement, so 'revivalist' is the correct noun/adjective.

question_text: Tosin refused to be _______, though he has written the same examination three times.
explanation: To be 'frustrated' means to feel annoyed or impatient because of inability to change or achieve something.

question_text: The police are looking for _______ car.
explanation: The correct adjective order is number (two), size (big), color (black).

question_text: I have no respect for individuals who are too _______.
explanation: 'Complaisant' means willing to please others or to accept what they do or say without protest.

question_text: My brother got married to a woman with _______.
explanation: 'Exquisite' means extremely beautiful and delicate.

question_text: The carpenter asked for ten packets of _______.
explanation: The compound adjective 'fifteen-centimetre' is used to modify 'nails'.

question_text: When I was in the secondary school, my parents were active members of the _______.
explanation: The correct title is 'Parents Teachers Association'.

question_text: Proprietors take joy in the _______ behaviour of their students.
explanation: 'Tricky' means difficult or unpredictable.

question_text: To be extravagant is to be _______.
explanation: To be 'extravagant' means to spend money or use resources recklessly; wasteful.

question_text: Tokyo is one of the developed _______.
explanation: 'Electronics centres' is the correct compound noun.

question_text: _______ old woman was attacked by a group of bandits.
explanation: The correct structure is 'A 90-year-old' (hyphenated compound adjective).

question_text: The prisoner was pleased to find _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is age (old), opinion (discarded), material (rubber).

question_text: The minister can't come today because he has _______.
explanation: A 'prior engagement' is a previously arranged commitment.

question_text: When the soldiers saw that resistance was _______, they stopped fighting.
explanation: 'Futile' means incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.

question_text: The exercise presented us with a lot of problems but later it was all _______.
explanation: 'Smooth' means without problems or difficulties.

question_text: In moments of serious economic hardship, many people are _______.
explanation: 'Disposed' means inclined or willing to do something.

question_text: The tourist bought _______.
option_a: a brown small Nigerian earthen pot
option_b: a small brown Nigerian earthen pot
option_c: an earthen brown small Nigerian pot
option_d: a brown big earthen small Nigerian pot
explanation: The correct adjective order is size, color, origin, material.

question_text: The baby was rather _______ than I could bear.
explanation: 'Much too troublesome' means excessively troublesome.

question_text: Old man's speech has become completely _______.
explanation: 'Incomprehensible' means not able to be understood.

question_text: The freed robber expressed his gratitude in a _______ prayer of thanksgiving.
explanation: A 'spontaneous' prayer is one done without premeditation.

question_text: By twelve midnight, we will be _______.
explanation: 'Airborne' means in the air; flying.

question_text: Mrs. Ojo was one of _______.
option_a: the first two enlightened young ladies
option_b: the two first enlightened young ladies
option_c: the two first young enlightened ladies
option_d: the first two young enlightened ladies
explanation: The correct order is 'the first two enlightened young ladies'.

question_text: The visitor was very uncomfortable because of his _______.
explanation: A 'runny nose' is the correct collocation.

question_text: The accident was due to _______.
explanation: 'Negligence' is the noun meaning failure to take proper care.

question_text: The group never felt strong enough to act in the open _______.
explanation: 'Covert' means not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret.

question_text: The Team Manager felt that the race could only be won by the _______ fore-foted C. bare-footed D. swift-footed
explanation: 'Swift-footed' means fast on foot.

question_text: To check desertification in the arid zones, _______ trees should be planted.
explanation: 'Drought resistant' is the correct compound adjective.

question_text: When Alike met her _______, she felt like reconciling with him.
explanation: An 'estranged' husband is one who is no longer living with their spouse.

question_text: A child that shows mature characteristics at an early age may be described as _______.
explanation: A 'precocious' child is one who has developed abilities earlier than usual.

question_text: I do not think any sane person would have acted in such a _______ manner.
explanation: 'Foolish' means lacking good sense or judgment.

question_text: Musa has lived here for five years but he does not seem able to get over the _______ about this town.
explanation: 'Bizarre' means very strange or unusual.

question_text: The future of the company is _______ though many seem _______ about it.
explanation: 'Rosy' means promising, and 'pessimistic' means expecting bad outcomes.

question_text: The other described the comment as _______.
explanation: 'Ludicrous' means so foolish or unreasonable as to be amusing; ridiculous.

question_text: He put _______ a white dozen eggs.
explanation: The correct order is number (dozen), color (white).

question_text: Ali plays _______.
explanation: 'A musical instrument' is the correct phrase.

question_text: The candidate's charisma should be a _______ factor in winning the election.
explanation: A 'determinant' factor is one that determines the outcome.

question_text: People dislike Mani because she is _______.
explanation: 'Tricky' means deceptive or difficult to deal with.

question_text: It is _______ their brothers.
explanation: 'Their brothers' is the correct possessive adjective + noun.

question_text: I am writing to you for _______.
explanation: 'A reply' is the correct phrase.

question_text: In spite of Shade's good looks, her hair is always _______.
explanation: 'Unkempt' means having an untidy or disheveled appearance.

question_text: The first prize was _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is opinion, participle, material.

question_text: The _______ a historic review of the history of the country has marked the beginning of a new life for the entire cabinet.
explanation: 'History' is the noun.

question_text: The old man was rushed to hospital when his blood pressure dropped to a _______ dangerous low level.
explanation: The adverb 'dangerously' modifies the adjective 'low'.

question_text: The _______ loquacious bus driver was quarreling, so nobody noticed the accident during the meeting.
explanation: 'Loquacious' means tending to talk a great deal; talkative.

question_text: The brave hunter killed _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is size, color, participle.

question_text: His father hardly mentions the news because he goes about with _______.
explanation: 'A portable radio' is the correct phrase.

question_text: The scholar examined _______.
explanation: The compound adjective 'part-analysis' is correct.

question_text: The litigants finally opted _______.
explanation: The correct phrase is 'opted for an out-of-court settlement'.

question_text: His mother always reprimands him for being a _______.
explanation: 'Voracious' reader of cheap novels means an eager reader.

question_text: I missed the match though it was shown on television on two _______.
explanation: 'Consecutive' means following continuously.

question_text: Adamu is quite _______ to pass the examination.
explanation: 'Doubtful' means uncertain about the outcome.

question_text: The new trade policy will facilitate _______.
explanation: The correct comparative structure is 'more rapid economic growth'.

question_text: Of the three girls, Uka is the _______.
explanation: 'Naughtiest' is the superlative form for three or more items.

question_text: Getting a well paid job nowadays is _______.
explanation: 'An uphill task' means a difficult task.

question_text: Everyone makes mistakes occasionally, nobody is _______.
explanation: 'Infallible' means incapable of making mistakes.

question_text: The woman would not part with her _______.
explanation: The correct adjective order is opinion, color, material.

question_text: Abike must have found the very interesting movies quite _______.
explanation: 'Absorbing' means intensely interesting.

question_text: When the strike is over, there will probably be an increase in wages and a _______ in prices.
explanation: 'Concurrent' means happening at the same time.
